Ref. 121987 – Compliance Manager (m/f/d) 

The WIRTGEN GROUP, a Deere & Company business, is a global leader in road construction and materials processing equipment, serving customers through five established product brands and an international network of manufacturing, sales, service, and dealer operations. As part of Deere & Company, WIRTGEN GROUP combines its deep industry expertise, strong customer relationships, and distinct business heritage with Deere’s global capabilities, values, and commitment to integrity. WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere operate within a shared Ethics and Compliance function, supported by common program expectations, systems, policies, and standards of ethical business conduct.

Deere and Company’s Global Ethics and Compliance department is looking for a

Compliance Manager (m/f/d) 

The Compliance Manager serves as the primary Ethics and Compliance partner for WIRTGEN GROUP globally, helping foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, and responsible business conduct across a complex international organization. The role operates as a broad-based compliance generalist, providing practical guidance and support across the full spectrum of ethics and compliance matters. Working closely with WIRTGEN GROUP stakeholders and businesses and the broader Deere and Company Ethics and Compliance team, this role supports compliance program implementation, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere and Company’s enterprise compliance framework.  The position is located in WIRTGEN GROUP’s headquarters, based in Windhagen, Germany.

Your Responsibilities: 

- Serve as the primary Compliance Manager supporting WIRTGEN GROUP globally, acting as the strategic interface on compliance risks, program expectations, regulatory matters, and alignment with Deere and Company’s Ethics and Compliance strategy
- Provide practical, business-oriented compliance guidance across a broad range of matters, including but not limited to: anti-bribery and anti-corruption, fraud risk, third-party relationships, trade compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, training, policy and regulatory interpretation, and employee questions or concerns.
- Implement, maintain, monitor, and manage compliance program elements for WIRTGEN GROUP, including policies, controls, third-party risk management activities, training, communications, monitoring, and reporting processes.
- Use data analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities to identify compliance trends, strengthen risk visibility, improve monitoring and reporting, and support more informed, risk-based decision-making, consistent with company policies and responsible AI principles.
- Partner with business leaders and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks, translating those risks into practical recommendations and actions.
- Support compliance risk assessments and related remediation activities, including the collection and analysis of information, documentation of findings, development of mitigation plans, and monitoring of agreed actions.
- Support the continued alignment of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere’s global compliance framework by helping implement enterprise policies, procedures, systems, controls, and compliance expectations across relevant operations, functions, and markets.
- Collaborate with Deere and Company’s Compliance Managers to identify, evaluate, escalate, and address compliance risks across multiple countries and jurisdictions.
- Facilitate information sharing and risk visibility for WIRTGEN and Deere and Company stakeholders, including emerging, complex, and cross-border compliance matters.
- Develop and support risk-based compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, management reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with WIRTGEN GROUP and Deere stakeholders, providing guidance, coaching, and support while promoting a culture of integrity, ethical behavior, transparency, and accountability.

What Skills You Need: 

- At least 5 years of practical experience working as a compliance specialist, compliance manager, or similar professional supporting a company’s broader ethics and compliance needs.
- Experience supporting or managing multiple elements of a corporate ethics and compliance program, such as risk assessment, training and communications, policy guidance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, fraud risk, trade compliance, monitoring, or reporting.
- Ability to operate as a compliance generalist, recognize issues across different compliance disciplines, provide sound initial guidance, and engage subject-matter specialists when appropriate.
- Strong business judgment and the ability to translate policies, regulatory expectations, and compliance requirements into practical guidance for business stakeholders.
- Ability to build relationships, establish credibility, and influence stakeholders across multiple cultures, business functions, organizational levels, and regions.
- Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex issues and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of integrity, discretion, and accountability.
- Professional proficiency in both English and German.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Experience supporting an international or multinational business with manufacturing, sales, service, distribution, or dealer operations.
- Working knowledge of anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, trade and sanctions compliance, conflicts of interest, gifts and entertainment, fraud risk, corporate codes of conduct, or investigatory practices.
- Experience conducting compliance risk assessments, developing risk mitigation plans, and monitoring remediation activities.
- Experience developing or delivering compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, dashboards, and management reporting.
- Ability to influence senior leaders and drive change through collaboration, credibility, and trust.
- Experience in process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Proficiency in additional languages.

Education: 

Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent level in Business Administration, Law, Compliance, Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Public Policy, or a related field

In addition to the gross monthly salary, the salary for this position (full-time) consists of various special payments. Depending on your experience, you can expect monthly starting salary of between 7,463 and 11,194 EUR in this position.

This exempt position is based in Windhagen, requires a regular on-site presence and it is vacant as soon as possible.

Job Grade: 9

End of Posting: 05.11.2026

jobs.description:
Douglas Service GmbH
Our Finance Solutions team is responsible for the SAP-based finance processes across the DOUGLAS Group. Together, we standardise, harmonise and simplify finance processes across all markets. In doing so, we deliver stable, future-proof solutions for Europe's leading omnichannel provider of premium beauty.
We are looking for you as Senior SAP Finance Consultant to actively shape the future of our global finance system landscape. In this role, you combine in-depth SAP Financial Accounting expertise with a strong understanding of processes, and you drive transformation projects in the SAP S/4HANA environment. Would you like to design finance processes across borders and take ownership of international projects? A committed team is looking forward to welcoming you.

TASKS WITH IMPACT

- You take functional responsibility for our SAP Finance solutions and advise the finance departments across the DOUGLAS Group on efficient and sustainable processes
- Analysing business requirements, you develop suitable solutions within the SAP standard and through targeted enhancements
- Designing and optimising end-to-end processes is at the heart of your role, with a focus on Financial Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Asset Accounting as well as banking and payment processes
- Seamless integration between SAP Financial Accounting and adjacent modules such as Sales & Distribution and Materials Management is your responsibility
- Leading projects and sub-projects independently, you coordinate collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
- As part of transformation and digitalisation initiatives, particularly in the SAP S/4HANA environment, you advance our finance system landscape. You also drive the standardisation, harmonisation and simplification of finance processes across all DOUGLAS markets
- Together with developers, key users and business departments, you ensure high quality in our solutions and processes

YOUR SKILLS

- You hold a degree in business informatics or business administration, or a comparable qualification
- Several years of professional experience as an SAP Financial Accounting Consultant in international SAP landscapes have given you very good knowledge of SAP Financial Accounting
- Your solid understanding of how Sales & Distribution and Materials Management integrate with Financial Accounting is complemented by experience in designing and implementing finance processes and system solutions
- Experience in steering projects or sub-projects is part of your background, and you are happy to get hands-on with implementation in the system
- Breaking down complex requirements in a structured way, you translate them into viable solutions and align them purposefully with stakeholders at different levels
- Ideally, you bring experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP transformation projects. Knowledge of SAP integrations and interfaces, e-invoicing and digital compliance requirements, as well as agile ways of working and ITIL-based service processes, is also desirable
- You communicate confidently in German and English, both spoken and written

jobs.occupation: 100% Remote Customer Success Manager – Hotel SaaS Platform (Hospitality Industry, DE & EN) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing company helping hotels and travel agencies automate their inbound communications using self-trained AI.

Our platform is designed specifically for reservation and group sales teams, helping them manage and respond to high volumes of inbound email communication more efficiently and consistently.

We integrate with hotel systems such as PMS and booking engines, but our core focus is improving how hotel teams handle guest and group requests via email in their daily operations.

We are a small, international team working in a trust-based, remote-first environment where ownership, clarity, and direct communication matter more than hierarchy.

Job Summary

This is a client success role focused on helping hotel reservation and group sales teams adopt new ways of working, integrate our system into their daily operations, and build long-term, trusted relationships.

You will act as the main point of contact for your clients and ensure the system becomes part of their day-to-day workflow, particularly in how they manage and respond to inbound emails, enquiries, and group requests.

The role is about driving real usage and long-term value in operational environments — not sales and not technical implementation.

You should understand how hotels operate, especially reservation or sales departments, and be comfortable working with hotel systems and communication workflows.

Attitude & Culture

Since this is a fully remote position within a small but close-knit international team, we place strong importance on finding someone who is comfortable working independently, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of their responsibilities.

We work in a trust-based, non-micromanaged environment. You have flexibility in how and when you work, and in return we expect reliability, accountability, and good judgement in managing your clients and responsibilities.

Support and collaboration are always available when needed, but this role is best suited to someone who is proactive, organised, and comfortable operating with a high level of autonomy.

We also place strong value on a healthy team and error culture. We focus on learning and improving together rather than assigning blame. Open, respectful communication is essential to us — disagreement is welcome, but personal attacks are not. Maintaining a constructive and collaborative environment is especially important in a fully remote company.

Your Impact

Client Success & Adoption

- Own relationships with hotel reservation and group sales teams
- Support teams in integrating the system into daily email-based workflows
- Ensure clients are actively using the platform in real operational settings
- Conduct regular online check-ins and occasional onsite visits (day trips)
- Identify gaps in adoption and proactively improve usage and engagement

The Voice of the Customer

- Act as the main bridge between hotel operations and our internal team
- Translate real operational challenges into structured, actionable feedback
- Ensure the system reflects how hotels actually manage guest and group communication in practice
- Help improve workflows, messaging, and configurations based on real-world usage

Relationship Ownership

- Build and maintain long-term, trusted relationships with hotel teams
- Monitor usage, engagement, and operational success over time
- Ensure clients consistently gain value from improved communication workflows
- Maintain accurate and structured records of client interactions and activity

Internal Collaboration

- Work closely with support, product, and technical teams
- Support smooth handovers from onboarding and implementation
- Contribute to improving internal processes based on real client feedback

Who You Are

The Hotel Operator

- 2–3 years experience in: - hotel reservations department, OR
- group sales department, OR
- front office with strong email handling responsibility
- Strong understanding of how hotel reservation and group email workflows operate in practice

The Communicator

- Fluent in German (C1 / business level – required)
- Fluent in English (required)
- Spanish is a plus, but not required
- Able to communicate clearly with both operational teams (e.g. reservations, group sales) and senior hotel or HQ management, adapting the message to the audience while keeping clarity and structure
- Comfortable proactively engaging with clients via email, phone, or online calls when needed to support adoption and ensure effective daily use of the system
- Able to help align day-to-day usage with longer-term operational goals and ensure the system is delivering value across both operational and management levels

Tech-Aware (but not technical)

- Understanding of hotel systems such as: - PMS
- Booking engines
- Channel managers (basic understanding)
- Comfortable learning and working with digital tools used for client management and reporting
- No coding required, but confident working with structured systems and workflows

Project Management (Nice to Have)

- Previous experience in project coordination or project management, or relevant training/certification, is a plus
- Comfortable coordinating tasks, tracking progress, and following up with different stakeholders to keep activities on schedule
- Able to manage multiple client priorities while maintaining clear communication and structured documentation

Ownership Mindset

- Works independently and takes responsibility for outcomes
- Structured, reliable, and proactive
- Identifies issues early and acts before escalation is needed

Growth & Development

This role offers clear long-term development opportunities into:

- Senior Customer Success roles
- Implementation / Operations Lead roles
- Product-facing or solution-focused positions
- Closer collaboration with product and operational strategy

We actively support learning, ownership, and internal progression.

Benefits

- 100% remote work environment
- Flexible working hours
- Flat hierarchy and direct access to decision-makers
- Supportive international team culture
- Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing company
- Company-provided equipment (Laptop + screen + keyboard + mouse)

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining:

- Your experience in hotel reservations or group sales
- Your experience handling high volumes of guest or group emails
- Why you are interested in hotel communication automation and operational improvement
- Your language skills and eligibility to work in Spain or Portugal

Please send applications to:
career@hotelresbot.com

Equal Opportunity Statement

Hotel Res Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment for all employees.

Bring customers, Technology and Commercial Success together

You are at home in international B2B sales, think commercially and know how to turn complex customer requirements into successful business relationships? Then join our Sales team in Leipzig.

As Senior Sales Manager, you will develop existing customer relationships, win new business and successfully position our combined Cell Testing and Module Testing portfolio in the market. You will connect customers and market needs with our teams in Leipzig and The Hague.

Your responsibilities

- Acquiring new customers and strategically developing existing customer relationships and accounts

- Create enthusiasm for our solutions, foster direct exchange with our teams and actively connect customers with our Leipzig site
- Prepare quotations, manage pricing and lead commercial negotiations
- Independently manage the complete sales process from first customer contact through to successful closing
- Take responsibility for your own pipeline management and sales forecasting 
- Work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Project Management and Customer Service as well as the international Sales and marketing team 
- Monitor market, customer and competitor developments and identify new business opportunities 
- Visit customers internationally and represent us at trade fairs, conferences and industry events, predominantly in Europe but not exclusively Europe 

Your profile

- Several years of solid international B2B sales experience at senior level 
- Experience with long and complex products and sales processes cycles 
- What matters is your strong sales background, not a technical or scientific degree 
- Strong commercial mindset and a good understanding of customer needs, business opportunities and company interests
- Proven experience in new customer acquisition, account development, pricing and commercial negotiations
- Confident communication, strong networking skills and the ability to connect with different people and interests
- Very good German and English skills
- Willingness to travel internationally for customer visits and business
- Experience in the solar industry is a plus, not a must

What we offer

- A responsible senior sales role in an international high-tech environment
- The opportunity to actively shape the growth of WAVELABS and Eternal Sun
- Direct cooperation with our Sales Director and the international Sales team
- A motivated team, short communication lines and plenty of room for initiative
- Flat hierarchies and an open, collegial working atmosphere
- Flexible working hours and a modern workplace at our Leipzig site

Who are we?

The solar industry is booming worldwide - and we are actively shaping it. WAVELABS has repositioned itself: with our new owner Eternal Sun, fresh capital and a committed team, we are back on a growth path. Our high-precision measurement systems help research institutes and manufacturers around the world develop and produce solar cells more efficiently and cost-effectively. The challenges of the market drive us. We believe in our technology, in our contribution to the energy transition and, above all, in the strength of our team. Together, we are writing the next chapter of WAVELABS - and we are looking for people who want to shape this journey with curiosity, initiative and enthusiasm.

LED'S SHINE TOGETHER
